title: WPA band members: Quinn Wilson, Henderson Smith and Yardbird Williams
summary: He recalls Punch Miller possibly, Quinn Wilson, Henderson Smith and trombonist Walter Yardbird Williams.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I understand Punch Miller was in your band for a while, there.
Maybe Punch was. That was so long ago, I had so many to go and come.
So many to go and come. Maybe he was. Punch was a heck of a player.
I had Quinn Wilson. Yeah, I had Quinn Wilson in the band. And I had Smitty in the band. All these are A number one musicians.
Yes, I know Quinn. Who's Smitty?
And what did he play? A trumpet player?
Yeah, trumpet player. They were very fine musicians. Had a fellow, we called him Yardbird. We called him Yardbird. His name was Walter Williams. Yardbird Williams. And he played --

Yeah, I don't know why they called him Yardbird. But that boy played so much horn, oh, he played trombone -- he played a trombone almost like the -- maybe they called him Yardbird because he played trombone almost like Parker would play the saxophone. Yeah, he played so much trombone.
This was earlier. This was before Charlie was -- Charlie was just a kid.
